## Summary
Classify each ContentChunk against LCME accreditation domains using Haiku, creating CLASSIFIED_UNDER edges from ContentChunk to LCMEStandard nodes in the knowledge graph.

## User story
As an accreditation officer, I want every piece of lecture content automatically classified against LCME standards, so that I can verify curriculum coverage and identify gaps before accreditation review.

## Why this matters
LCME accreditation is existential for MSM. If content coverage gaps are discovered during an accreditation visit, the school risks probation. Automated classification provides continuous coverage monitoring, replacing manual spreadsheet tracking that is error-prone and months out of date.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Each ContentChunk classified against LCME domain taxonomy (seeded in E01-S06)
- [ ] Classification uses HAIKU_MODEL constant (Rule 4) — classification is lightweight
- [ ] Content sent to Haiku uses sanitizeForContext + buildContextBlock (Rule 5)
- [ ] Claude responses parsed with safeJsonParse (Rule 2)
- [ ] Batch classification uses Promise.allSettled (Rule 3)
- [ ] CLASSIFIED_UNDER edge: ContentChunk → LCMEStandard with confidence score
- [ ] Classification results stored in Supabase FIRST, Neo4j SECOND (Rule 6)
- [ ] Multi-label: a chunk can map to 0-3 LCME standards (no forced classification)
- [ ] Low-confidence classifications (<0.6) flagged for faculty review
- [ ] Prompt committed to packages/ai/prompts/lcme-classifier.md

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// apps/inngest/functions/p1-steps/lcme-classify.ts
import { HAIKU_MODEL } from '@journey/ai/constants'
import { safeJsonParse } from '@journey/ai/safe-parse'
import { sanitizeForContext, buildContextBlock } from '@journey/ai/sanitize'
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'

interface LCMEClassification {
  lcme_standard_code: string
  confidence: number
}

export async function lcmeClassify(
  chunks: ContentChunk[],
  institutionId: string
) {
  const supabase = createServerClient()

  // Load LCME taxonomy for prompt context
  const { data: standards } = await supabase
    .from('lcme_standards')
    .select('id, code, title, description')

  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    chunks.map(async (chunk) => {
      const sanitized = sanitizeForContext(chunk.text)
      const context = buildContextBlock('lecture_content', sanitized)

      const response = await anthropic.messages.create({
        model: HAIKU_MODEL,
        system: lcmeClassifierPrompt, // from packages/ai/prompts/lcme-classifier.md
        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: context }],
        max_tokens: 512,
      })

      const { data } = safeJsonParse<{ classifications: LCMEClassification[] }>(
        response.content[0].text
      )
      return {
        chunkId: chunk.id,
        classifications: (data?.classifications || []).slice(0, 3), // Max 3
      }
    })
  )

  // 1. Write to Supabase FIRST (Rule 6)
  // 2. Create Neo4j edges SECOND (Rule 6)
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E03/E03-S08.pipeline.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'

test.describe('E03-S08: LCME domain classification', () => {
  test('Chunks have LCME classifications in Supabase', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/lcme-classifications`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      expect(data.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
      for (const classification of data) {
        expect(classification.content_chunk_id).toBeTruthy()
        expect(classification.lcme_standard_id).toBeTruthy()
        expect(classification.confidence).toBeGreaterThan(0)
        expect(classification.confidence).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1)
      }
    }
  })

  test('Multi-label: chunks can have 0-3 LCME classifications', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/lcme-classifications`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      // Group by chunk
      const byChunk = new Map<string, any[]>()
      for (const c of data) {
        if (!byChunk.has(c.content_chunk_id)) byChunk.set(c.content_chunk_id, [])
        byChunk.get(c.content_chunk_id)!.push(c)
      }
      for (const [, classifications] of byChunk) {
        expect(classifications.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(3)
      }
    }
  })

  test('Low-confidence classifications flagged for review', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/lcme-classifications?flagged=true`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      for (const classification of data) {
        expect(classification.flagged_for_review).toBe(true)
        expect(classification.confidence).toBeLessThan(0.6)
      }
    }
  })

  test('Negative: classification references valid LCME standard', async ({ request }) => {
    const classRes = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/lcme-classifications`
    )
    const standardsRes = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lcme-standards`
    )
    if (classRes.ok() && standardsRes.ok()) {
      const { data: classifications } = await classRes.json()
      const { data: standards } = await standardsRes.json()
      const standardIds = new Set(standards.map((s: any) => s.id))
      for (const c of classifications) {
        expect(standardIds.has(c.lcme_standard_id)).toBe(true)
      }
    }
  })
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS chunk_lcme_classifications;`
2. Neo4j: `MATCH ()-[r:CLASSIFIED_UNDER]->() DELETE r`
3. Neo4j: `MATCH (cc:ContentChunk) REMOVE cc.lcme_classified`
4. `git stash && git checkout develop`
